purpose: First+last frame conditioning. Same-ref holds identity; same-style pairs test interpolation.

defaults.negative_prompt: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, morphing face, identity change, style change, different person, warped anatomy, abrupt cut

lock_preamble: Condition on first and last frames. Honor both endpoint images. Smooth motion between them; keep style consistent with the endpoints.

cases.prompt: Start and end on the same clinic photoreal still of the woman and dog. In the middle: soft blink, breath, tiny hand stroke. Return to the same pose by the last frame. Style stays photoreal.
Start and end on the same anime alley still. Middle: tiny turn and hair motion, then settle back. Stay anime illustration throughout.
Start and end on the same anime armor still. Middle: small wave then hand lowers back. Anime style locked.
Start and end on the same station photoreal still. Middle: map adjust and smile, then return. Photoreal locked.
First and last frames match the clinic still. She starts to stand in the middle then settles back toward the kneeling endpoint. Same woman, dog, photoreal.
First and last frames match the anime alley still. She steps deeper then returns toward the starting framing. Anime style locked.
Photoreal only. Interpolate smoothly from the clinic woman+dog first frame toward the station man+map last frame. Keep photographic realism; expect subject change between endpoints.
Photoreal only. Interpolate from the station man first frame toward the clinic woman+dog last frame. Smooth transition, photographic style throughout.
Anime illustration only. Interpolate from alley girl first frame toward armored convention girl last frame. Stay 2D anime; never photoreal.
Anime illustration only. Interpolate from armored girl first frame toward alley girl last frame. Stay anime lineart/cel style throughout.
